brief: The canvas is filled with a constantly shifting, symmetrical kaleidoscope pattern. The structure appears to be an infinitely magnified view of a soapy surface, generating perpetual radial glow. Colors transition smoothly and richly across the field, moving through the vibrant spectrum of a glowing sunset—deep reds, bright oranges, and molten yellows. The hexagons and repeating circular forms seem to pulse and ripple, giving the impression of movement deep within a luminous, microscopic space. The entire display cycles endlessly without requiring any interaction.
